attributes.value: geometric sequence starting at 2^(-8/n) with ratio 2^(-8/n)
attributes.quote:
In general, for $n$ heads, our set of slopes is the geometric sequence that starts at
$2^{\frac{-8}{n}}$
and uses that same value as its ratio.

new_ops.name: alibi_attention
new_ops.reason: Causal multi-head softmax attention whose scores q_i.k_j receive an additive, non-learned per-head bias -m_h*(i-j) (applied after the sqrt(d_k) scaling, not multiplied by it), with head slopes m_h = (2^(-8/n))^h for h=1..n. Needs an attention primitive with a per-head linear distance bias [heads, T, T].

output.notes: Headline model is the 1.3B CC100+RoBERTa ALiBi model (trained at L=1024 per abstract; also L=512, 2048 variants). The WikiText-103 config is the Baevski & Auli model with ALiBi, trained at L from 64 to 3072, so its context length is left not_stated. The paper does not state the norm type or placement, the FFN activation, the residual structure, biases, vocab or head_dim for either model, so the block lists only the attention part. The norm, residual adds and FFN are omitted rather than guessed. Tied embeddings are stated only for the Baevski WikiText model and the books model, which conflicts with adaptive input/softmax, so this is not_stated for the 1.3B model.
